info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Workforce Contracts API
info.description: The Workforce Contracts API enables organizations to access and manage workforce contract information effectively. It provides endpoints to retrieve detailed data about contracts associated with employees, allowing HR professionals and business managers to ensure compliance and track workforce agreements efficiently. Typical use cases include monitoring contract expiration, auditing contract terms, and analyzing workforce engagement. This API serves as a critical resource for businesses seeking to streamline their human resource management operations.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of workforce contracts.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch all workforce contracts within the human resource management system. It provides a comprehensive view of existing contracts, including details such as contract duration, employee assignments, and contract terms.
